# GitHub Copilot System Instructions

## Language Preferences
- Respond to all chat messages and explanations in Catalan.
- Write code comments, docstrings, and technical documentation in English.
- Ensure all user interface (UI) texts, labels, and frontend strings are written in Catalan.

## Core Tech Stack
- **Database:** Supabase
- **Frontend / UI:** Streamlit (always use Streamlit for any UI components, views, or data presentation)
- **Analytics & Backend:** Python
- Do not introduce new libraries, frameworks, or cloud providers unless explicitly requested.

## Code Quality & Architecture
- Follow clean code principles and SOLID design patterns strictly.
- Optimize code for high performance and security (e.g., prevent SQL injection, secure environment variables).
- Write modular, reusable, and easily testable Python functions and Streamlit components.

## Output Style
- Be concise and direct. Avoid conversational filler, apologies, or boilerplate introductions/conclusions.
- Provide the exact code solution immediately.
